sources.title: Rega Voice — text to speech in Kurdish and Arabic
sources.snippet: Rega Voice turns a script into speech in Sorani, Arabic, Turkish, Persian, English, or Chinese — streamed as it renders, sealed with provenance, yours to publish.

sources.title: RegaLabs | Voice infrastructure for every conversation
sources.snippet: RegaLabs serves Sorani, Turkish, Persian, Arabic, English, and Chinese voice, with Badini and Kurmanji recognition, translation, and subtitles.
